subject: general
question: Where did Gautam Buddha deliver his first sermon?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sarnath.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Buddhism,** one of the world's largest religions, has its roots in India and stretches back 2,500 years.
 
• **Medieval Buddhist **art frequently featured the Buddha's first sermon, which was delivered in a deer woodland.
 
• The term** "Dhamma Chakka Pavattana," **which means "spinning the wheel of dharma," refers to this occasion.
 
• The Buddha gave his first lecture in a **deer forest at Sarnath**, north of Bodhgaya, where he had attained enlightenment weeks before, is a common motif in mediaeval Buddhist art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Buddhists hold that **enlightenment or nirvana can be attained via meditation, hard work** both physically and spiritually, and good conduct. They also hold that human life is one of suffering.
 
• Buddhism is an** Indian religion or philosophical school **that is founded on teachings credited to the Buddha also known by the names **Buddha Dharma and Dharmavinaya.**
 
• With **Siddhartha Gautama**, it began in India about the fifth century BCE, and throughout the following millennia, it spread throughout Asia and the rest of the world.
